title: [Aver] Lesson Detail Navigation - Action Area - Middle recurring lesson - Previous Lesson and Next Lesson enabled
description: AC 01.1 / AC 01.3 - Decision Table - Middle lesson in a recurring chain shows both lesson-navigation buttons as active controls on BO Lesson Detail.
preconditions:
- Logged in to Back Office as HQ or CM Staff with access to Aver lesson detail.
- Recurring lesson chain RC-1001 exists with three lessons: LES-1001 (first), LES-1002 (middle), LES-1003 (last).
- LES-1002 detail page is open in BO Lesson Detail view mode.
steps_actions:
1. Open BO Lesson Detail for LES-1002 in the recurring chain.
2. Observe the top action area of Lesson Detail.
3. Hover or focus on both lesson-navigation buttons.
steps_result:
1. Lesson Detail page for LES-1002 loads without redirecting to another surface.
2. Previous Lesson and Next Lesson buttons are both visible in the action area.
3. Both buttons remain enabled and interactive.
steps_data:
1. recurring_chain = RC-1001; lesson = LES-1002
2. expected_buttons = Previous Lesson, Next Lesson
3. expected_state = enabled
suite: [Aver] BO Lesson Detail Navigation - Button Visibility and Boundary States

title: [Aver] Lesson Detail Navigation - Boundary State - First recurring lesson - Previous Lesson disabled

preconditions:
- Logged in to Back Office as HQ or CM Staff with access to Aver lesson detail.
- Recurring lesson chain RC-1001 exists with LES-1001 as the first lesson and LES-1002 as the next lesson.
- LES-1001 detail page is open in BO Lesson Detail view mode.
steps_actions:
1. Open BO Lesson Detail for the first lesson LES-1001.
2. Observe the lesson-navigation buttons in the action area.
3. Attempt to click Previous Lesson.
steps_result:
1. Lesson Detail page for LES-1001 loads.
2. Previous Lesson is visible but disabled, and Next Lesson is visible and enabled.
3. No navigation occurs and the current lesson remains LES-1001.
steps_data:
1. recurring_chain = RC-1001; lesson = LES-1001
2. previous_state = disabled; next_state = enabled
3. blocked_action = Previous Lesson
